refund-enterprise.text: No. The refund policy does not apply to enterprise contracts. Enterprise customers who want money back raise a billing dispute with their account manager, who reviews it within ten business days.
refund-enterprise.note: Right, with the next step spelled out.

standard-refund-window.text: Standard customers can request a refund within 30 days of delivery.
standard-refund-window.note: Right: the same answer the small tier gives, at five times the price.

dock-door-red-light.text: No. Never open a dock door showing a red light. The red light means no trailer is in place at that door.

card-data-retention.text: Larkspur keeps only the last four digits and the expiry month of a customer's card, for 90 days after the last order. The two-year figure is about demo cards.
card-data-retention.note: Right: it told the demo cards apart from customers' cards.

same-day-cutoff.text: Orders for in-stock items placed before 2 p.m. Central time on a business day ship the same day; later orders ship the next business day.
same-day-cutoff.note: Right: the same fact as the small tier, with the next step.

vague-outage.text: For a Portal outage outside business hours, call the Duty Desk at extension 4410 to page the on-call engineer. In business hours, the support desk can help.
vague-outage.note: Right: it read the vague question as an outage and found the out-of-hours number.

payment-methods.text: The Portal accepts company credit cards and purchase orders for approved accounts, plus bank transfer.
payment-methods.note: Wrong for both tiers: the digital-wallet line sits in a passage retrieval never sends, so no model size helps.

kestrel-purchase-approver.text: Tomasz Rehnquist, Director of Warehouse Technology. The Fulfillment Systems team owns the Kestrel K2 integration, and he approves that team's purchases.

k2-volume-price.text: A Kestrel K2 handheld scanner costs $410 per unit when you order 50 or more.
k2-volume-price.note: Right: the same price the small tier read.

customer-success-lead.text: Ingrid Vasquez-Lund leads the Customer Success team.
